patch_description: Replace the random, unoptimized point cloud with a deterministic multiscale maximin search. Three fixed simplex vertices guarantee a convex hull of constant area, while the remaining ten points are optimized inside that hull. The objective is a numerically stable soft minimum of all 286 normalized triangle areas; its temperature decreases through the run, transitioning from broad distribution improvement to direct optimization of the smallest triangles. Batched candidate perturbations provide efficient vectorized exploration, and the best true minimum-area configuration is retained for return.
